title: Wooden Crate (regular)
summary: A movable 4 HP crate that can be stacked to gain elevation.

fields.Durability: 4 HP. Resists Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, is vulnerable to Bludgeoning and immune to Poison and Psychic. Weighs about 22 lb.
fields.Stacking: Stack movable crates to gain height and change throwing and falling damage.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
